inputs.produce_note: 150 kg = rated capacity. Always 150 kg inside; 150 kg swapped every day (in the loading events below).
inputs.loading_note: Each loading event = 2 door openings (out + in, 10 min apart). If there is only one event, 2 more openings at 12:00 and 17:00 (4 a day in total).
inputs.sun_factor_note: Open-Meteo sunlight x 0.88 = NASA POWER level for Jan-Aug 2026 (conservative). Set 1.0 for uncorrected Open-Meteo.

night_fan.note: 12 V DC axial fan(s) at the TOP of a baffle channel (thin sheet 5 cm in front of the wax panels, open top and bottom), blowing DOWN. Runs only when the compressor is off and the room is above 5 C; variable speed (PWM) to hold about 6.7 C (just under the 7 C design limit). All fan power is heat added to the room.

battery_12V.note: Only for controller, sensors and IoT gateway (10 W = 0.24 kWh/day, about 2 days without sun at 80 % depth of discharge). NO battery for cooling: the wax is the storage.

money.note: ALL PRICES ARE GUESSES - check locally. Power cut 10:00-18:00 is an ASSUMPTION (editable). CO2: CEA India grid baseline ~0.71 kg/kWh; diesel 2.68 kg/L.
